title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jd_text:
We are looking for a Senior Site Reliability Engineer to support production cloud platforms.

Responsibilities include Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, Azure, Prometheus, Grafana, Jenkins, GitHub Actions, observability, incident management, SLI, SLO, error budgets, automation, RCA and postmortems.

The engineer will participate in production troubleshooting, reliability engineering, capacity planning and continuous improvement.
